pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0131 governed runtime evidence
pr_body:
## Summary

Extends ADR0131 first-release support with a session-scoped persistent code workspace and restart-safe baseline provenance. Managed code work now survives across runs in the same AI session, preserves stale-file protection across Editor restarts, and records reviewable run-level code checkpoints without changing canonical authoring or Git history.

The existing governed runtime evidence, permission, MCP authoring, managed validation, and Draft PR contracts remain unchanged.
